CROWS.Condition.blessedHint: You gain an edge on all tests, and attacks you make deal additional damage equal to the characteristic used. Ends at the end of the dungeon turn.
CROWS.Condition.grabbedHint: Your speed is 0, you can't flank, and attacks against you gain an edge. You move with your grabber.
CROWS.Condition.proneHint: Your speed is halved. You take a bane on melee attacks and can't flank. Melee attacks against you gain an edge; ranged attacks against you take a bane.
CROWS.Condition.unconsciousHint: You're prone, your speed is 0, and you can't act. Automatic doom on Agility and Strength tests, double bane on Mind tests to notice your surroundings. Attacks against you always achieve a tier 3 result.
CROWS.Condition.vulnerableHint: Each time you take damage, take an extra 1d6. Ends at the end of the dungeon turn.
CROWS.Condition.weakenedHint: You take a bane on all tests. Ends at the end of the dungeon turn.
CROWS.Expertise.alchemyHint: Make and know about potions, poisons, and bombs.
CROWS.Expertise.blacksmithingHint: Make and know about metal tools, armor, and weapons.
CROWS.Expertise.enchantingHint: Make and know about magic items.
CROWS.Expertise.enduranceHint: Remain engaged in strenuous physical or mental activity for a long time period.
CROWS.Expertise.gymnasticsHint: Move across unsteady or narrow surfaces; tumble.
CROWS.Expertise.liftHint: Pick up, carry, and throw heavy objects.
CROWS.Expertise.magicLoreHint: Know about magical places, spells, items, and phenomena.
CROWS.Expertise.monsterLoreHint: Know monster ecology, strengths, and weaknesses.
CROWS.Expertise.natureLoreHint: Know about natural flora, fauna, and weather.
CROWS.Expertise.pickLockHint: Open a lock without the key.
CROWS.Expertise.religiousLoreHint: Know about religious mythology and practices.
CROWS.Expertise.searchHint: Search an environment for important details and items.
CROWS.Expertise.thieveryHint: Disable mechanical devices, open locks, pick pockets, and general sleight of hand.

CROWS.Warn.expertiseOverBudget: This crow holds {over} more expertise uses than its advancement allows. Migrated from Playtest 1; the Ref can rebalance.
CROWS.Warn.orphanedWounds: {count} wound(s) sit in backpack slots this crow no longer has.
CROWS.Warn.magicSlotOverload: More than one magic item in the same slot: you can't rest, and you gain 1d6 wounds at the end of each dungeon turn.
